verdict.rationale: Canva ships an official CLI (`@canva/cli`) documented for creating/managing Canva apps, and a runtime probe confirms it runs keylessly via npx and reports a version, corroborating first-party docs. missing for 10: no evidence the CLI itself exposes AI-native/agentic commands (agentic access is instead delivered via the separate MCP server), and no independent third-party review of the CLI's UX.
